content.text: Found it. The commit `b83ce94c63ec1891f5b76837455c8b2a53ad9d9c` (Sep 18, 2015, "Dan Van Atta") replaced a correct `if / else if` pair (that played the combat-move sound and set `m_soundPlayedAlreadyCombatMove`) with a single combined `if ((nonCombat && !flag1) || (!nonCombat && !flag2))` condition whose body only sets `m_soundPlayedAlreadyNonCombatMove`, never `m_soundPlayedAlreadyCombatMove`. This is exactly the bug that the supplied fix commit `9a02e14e1` reverts back into two independent `if` blocks.
